question.prompt: Casey’s shop class is making a golf trophy. He has to paint \(300\) dimples on a golf ball. If it takes him \(2\) seconds to paint one dimple, how many minutes will he need to do his job?

solutions.explanation:
Each of the \(300\) dimples takes \(2\) seconds, so the total painting time is
\[
300\cdot2=600\text{ seconds}.
\]
Since one minute contains \(60\) seconds, this is
\[
600\div60=\boxed{10\text{ minutes}},
\]
choice \(\mathrm{D}\).
solutions.title: Find the total seconds, then convert
